summary: Iteration 23 - Food Allergen feature end-to-end verification for Cravitoo. Backend: ALL 20 tests in test_allergen_classifier.py pass (13 unit + 7 HTTP integration) covering canonical taxonomy classification, normalize_allergens (case-insensitive + unknown-drop), reclassify_batch only_missing/overwrite semantics, Excel bulk-upload auto-classify on empty allergens column, POST /api/onboarding/vendors/{onb_id}/menu accepting+normalising allergens, PATCH accepting allergens partial update, POST /api/onboarding/vendors/{onb_id}/menu/reclassify-allergens (overwrite=false preserves manual, overwrite=true flips), POST /api/admin/menu-items/reclassify-allergens auth (401 unauth, 200 master+scope). Backward-compat regression: re-ran test_onboarding_menu (15), test_free_menu_photos (9), test_ai_photos_and_agreement (9 incl 2 live-AI), test_ai_photo_spend (5), test_storage_upload (11), test_session_persistence (16) = 65/65 pass. No allergen-field addition broke veg/menu compat. Frontend smoke (admin @ desktop 1920x1080): login OK, /onboarding/{draft_id} Menu tab renders menu-tab-container, Add-item modal shows all 10 menu-form-allergen-{milk,nuts,peanuts,gluten,soy,sesame,egg,fish,shellfish,mustard} chips, clicking chip toggles amber-500 active state correctly. Table on active-vendor onboarding shows the new 'Allergens' column and 3 menu-row-allergens-{item_id} cells. reclassify-allergens-btn is correctly items.length>0-gated (visible on populated menus, hidden on empty drafts - by design). All required data-testids from the review request are present in source and rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: allergen_classifier.py: clean, small (160 LOC), canonical-order-preserving, well-documented Indian-cuisine token buckets (paneer/kaju/moongfali/anda/sarson etc). Word-boundary regex avoids false positives. reclassify_batch is non-destructive when only_missing=True.

MenuTab.js: ALLERGEN_OPTIONS array is a duplicate of backend ALLERGEN_KEYS - acceptable for a small taxonomy but any future changes must be applied to BOTH files (a code comment on both files already flags this).

employee/Menu.js PREF_TO_CANONICAL mapping is the critical bridge between the free-form Preferences allergy labels and canonical keys - the mapping covers the 10 canonical keys plus common synonyms (dairy->milk, tree nuts->nuts, wheat->gluten, eggs->egg). Missing labels are silently dropped by .filter(Boolean) which is safe.

reclassifyAllergens in MenuTab.js uses window.confirm() twice in a row (OK->overwrite, Cancel->only-missing) which is a bit clunky UX - a proper modal with two explicit buttons would be nicer but functionally it works.
MenuTab.js reclassify-veg-btn and reclassify-allergens-btn are gated by `items.length > 0` - correct (nothing to classify when list is empty).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (data-testids present, chip toggle works, allergens column renders, add-modal picker renders 10/10)

seed_data_creation: TEST__alrg_Vendor_* scratch onboarding rows are auto-cleaned by scratch_onboarding fixture via cascade DELETE. No lingering TEST_ rows.
